speak.title: Role-play: booking a first appointment
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A caller wants to book therapy. The free waiting list is about five months. A private session this week costs 70 pounds. Explain both choices, ask what the caller can manage, and suggest one more option.

b.text: You've felt very stressed for weeks and want to see a therapist soon. You can't afford much money and you don't want to wait for months. Ask questions and try to find a solution.

phrases: I'd like to book an appointment, please.
How long is the waiting list?
I'm afraid it's about five months.
That's too long for me, I'm struggling now.
We could offer you a shorter course of sessions.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class what the caller decided, and say why.
